experiment_data.hypothesis: Temporal Conditioning Noise (TCN): adding Gaussian noise (sigma=0.5) to dt_embedding during imagination rollouts reduces dt conditioning precision, preventing critic from learning dt-specific value bias. Predicts CIVO suppression (NVE < 1.5×) with eval > 50% baseline (~450+). Based on obs-decoder SGS failure (gradient-level intervention insufficient) → need forward-pass/representation-level intervention.

experiment_data.analysis_summary: TCN (σ=0.5 noise on dt_embedding) FAILED to suppress CIVO. NVE breached 1.5× threshold 3 times: 55K(1.68×), 65K(1.54×), 85K(3.97×). Peak NVE 3.97× at 85K is HIGHER than typical CIVO, suggesting TCN destabilizes value learning. Eval peaked at 240 (35K), then collapsed to avg 117 in latter half — far below 450 target. Gate remained fixed at dt=2 throughout (zero entropy). The noise magnitude was insufficient to decorrelate critic estimates from dt conditioning. Training reached 120K/210K planned. Hypothesis falsified: forward-pass noise at σ=0.5 does not prevent critic from exploiting dt-specific value structure.
